See DESIGN.md 'Any registered human may endorse'.\nDECIDED (Mark, 2026-10-22) D6: approver steps down (tier record deleted/lowered, or removed from anchors.json, not compromised): tiers they granted stay valid. Authority is judged at the commit that added the tier record (git history, per metarule). Only a revoked key voids what it signed. Current code hard-fails check in this case (git-vouch:967-972) - must change to: valid if the approver held authority when the record was committed."}
